test_cases.name: happy_path_multi_item_serial
test_cases.description: Multi-item serial execution where each item completes full lifecycle (VALIDATING -> PROCESSING -> VERIFYING) with all standard log markers and context purge before advancing.
test_cases.input: Execute serial-item-processor for batch serial-acc-001 with input items [{"name": "alpha"}, {"name": "beta"}, {"name": "gamma"}].

test_cases.name: single_item_boundary_condition
test_cases.description: Boundary condition with exactly one item executing complete lifecycle without index overflow.
test_cases.input: Execute serial-item-processor for batch serial-single-001 with 1 item [{"name": "solo_item"}].

test_cases.name: empty_input_array_boundary
test_cases.description: Supplying zero elements triggers immediate transition to terminal summary with empty table and EMPTY_INPUT_ARRAY notification.
test_cases.input: Execute serial-item-processor for batch serial-empty-001 with empty input items [].

test_cases.name: item_validation_failure_recovery
test_cases.description: Item fails precondition validation, skips processing and verification, emits FAIL, purges context, and proceeds to subsequent item.
test_cases.input: Execute serial-item-processor for batch serial-val-fail with [{"name": "invalid_doc"}, {"name": "valid_doc"}]. Assume invalid_doc fails validation.

test_cases.name: item_processing_failure_recovery
test_cases.description: Item fails during core processing, skips verification, logs FAIL, purges context, and continues with remaining items.
test_cases.input: Execute serial-item-processor for batch serial-proc-fail with [{"name": "faulty_task"}, {"name": "healthy_task"}]. Assume faulty_task encounters unhandled processing error.

test_cases.name: item_verification_failure_recovery
test_cases.description: Item fails verification checklist / DoD, records FAIL, purges context, and continues.
test_cases.input: Execute serial-item-processor for batch serial-verif-fail with [{"name": "unverified_item"}, {"name": "good_item"}]. Assume unverified_item fails ASCII or DoD check.

test_cases.name: abort_on_first_error_enforcement
test_cases.description: When abort_on_first_error is true, first item failure terminates pipeline immediately, skipping remaining items.
test_cases.input: Execute serial-item-processor for batch serial-abort-001 with abort_on_first_error: true and items [{"name": "item_err"}, {"name": "item_skipped"}]. item_err fails validation.

test_cases.name: violation_lookahead_detected
test_cases.description: Detects and prohibits preemptive inspection or reasoning about item N+1 while item N is active.
test_cases.input: Process [{"name": "item_1"}, {"name": "item_2"}]. While validating item_1, also check parameters of item_2.

test_cases.name: violation_batch_pollution_detected
test_cases.description: Detects and prohibits batching items into shared concurrent execution or multi-item summaries prior to Phase 3.
test_cases.input: Process [{"name": "X"}, {"name": "Y"}]. Generate a joint analysis for X and Y together before running verification.
prohibited_output_patterns: Joint summary for X and Y

test_cases.name: invalid_config_schema_validation
test_cases.description: Rejects malformed batch_id or missing required fields according to SerialProcessorConfig schema.
test_cases.input: Initialize serial-item-processor with batch_id "invalid_id_format" (missing serial- prefix) and empty input_items.
